title: Uploading defect photos
passage:
Have you uploaded the defect photos yet?
A. Not yet; the wireless connection is down. B. Only two units failed. C. They prefer the glossy finish.
passageZh:
你已經上傳缺陷照片了嗎？
A. 還沒；無線網路連線中斷了。
B. 只有兩台未通過。
C. 他們比較喜歡亮面處理。
